title: QB6#q2 and the QB6 cheat sheet still taught DWT as the universal CII capacity measure after CORR-GPT-T3C-CII-20260905 corrected q1, leaving QB6.html teaching two versions of one unit
authorisation_source: Founder brief PRE-TRANCHE-4 PROPAGATION CLEANUP, sections 1-3, which names QB6#q2 and QB6_cheatsheet as two of exactly three authorised residuals and bounds the sweep to the same already-adjudicated proposition.
candidate_claim: Not raised by a candidate. This is the carry-forward that CORR-GPT-T3C-CII-20260905 recorded against itself: its own propagation.found_and_not_swept names QB6#q2 and QB6_cheatsheet.html as the highest-priority unswept sites of the defect it had just corrected in q1.
candidate_verdict: UPHELD, WITH ONE CORRECTION TO THE PREDECESSOR RECORD'S OWN COUNT. CORR-GPT-T3C-CII-20260905 recorded 'QB6#q2 ... carries the universal DWT form at 4 sites' in found_and_not_swept, while its scope_pass line for the same file says 'QB6.html 14 (9 in q1, 5 in q2)'. The record contradicts itself and the higher figure is the right one: q2 carried the literal gCO2/DWT.nm at FIVE sites. All five are corrected here. The undercount is recorded rather than quietly absorbed, because a deferral list is the instruction the next pass works from, and a deferral list that undercounts by one is how a residual survives a cleanup that believes it is complete.

authority.instrument: Resolution MEPC.412(84), Amendments to the 2022 Guidelines on operational carbon intensity indicators and the calculation methods (CII Guidelines, G1), adopted 1 May 2026 at MEPC 84. Held at docs/sources/MEPC.412-84.pdf, sha256 f7288ea29f59597f3c7a6c74be51e0d88395d34762ab926a697723afb30d2b7a. Registered SRC-IMO-MEPC412-84-CII-G1.
authority.acquisition: NONE REQUIRED BY THIS PASS. The instrument was acquired, hash-pinned, registered and read in full by CORR-GPT-T3C-CII-20260905 earlier the same day. This record adds no source and asserts no proposition that record did not already establish; it only extends the corrected wording to the two surfaces that record deferred.
authority.proposition: The supply-based transport work Ws is the product of the ship's capacity C and the total distance travelled Dt. C is DWT for bulk carriers, tankers, container ships, gas carriers, LNG carriers, general cargo ships, refrigerated cargo carriers and combination carriers; C is GT for cruise passenger ships, ro-ro cargo ships (vehicle carriers), ro-ro cargo ships and ro-ro passenger ships. There is therefore no universal DWT denominator.

cards.supersedes_note: q2 has never been pinned by any earlier correction or batch record. CORR-CII-G2G4-20260901 and CORR-GPT-T3C-CII-20260905 both pin QB6#q1 only. No ancestry is rewritten and no historical record is rebaselined by this action.
cards.rationale: Five sites, all of them positive teaching of a universal DWT denominator, all now expressing capacity with the ship-type split. (1) The CII-vs-GFI contrast list, where the unit is the entire content of the row. (2) The Key Numbers 'CII unit' line. (3) The trap answer to 'GFI and CII measure the same thing', which had to state the CII unit correctly to make its own point. (4) The Common CE Failures entry on confusing the two units. (5) The Numbers to Memorise 'CII unit' line. The 15-second and 60-second answers were NOT touched: neither states a CII unit - q2 is a GFI card and its short layers describe CII only as 'operational efficiency ... (Tank-to-Wake)'. The brief required the short layers to stay concise, and here that is achieved by leaving them alone rather than by compressing a correction into them.
surfaces_deliberately_not_touched: GFI formula block, GFI reference baselines, CE Relevance, casualty link, examiner chain, On My Vessel and the reg box - all GFI content, outside the adjudicated proposition
cards.classification_note: PRIMARY rather than PROPAGATED. Relative to CORR-GPT-T3C-CII-20260905 this card is a propagation, and the title and rationale say so. But within THIS record it is the reported defect - the thing the brief named and the reason the record exists - and the schema's exactly_one_primary_correction check is asking which card is this record's ORIGIN, since 'zero means the record has lost its origin'. Classifying it PROPAGATED would leave this record with no origin at all while adding nothing about the lineage that the title, the candidate_claim and this note do not already state.

propagation.sweep_definition: Bounded to the single adjudicated proposition - positive teaching of a universal DWT denominator for CII. Pattern set run over every candidate-facing HTML surface under meoclass1/ (question banks, cheat sheets, oralnotes, solved past papers, hub): gCO2/DWT, gCO2 / DWT, per DWT-mile, per DWT.nm, DWT.nm, DWT-nm, DWT x distance. Run before and after the edits.

B_correctly_scoped_DWT_for_specific_ship: QB7_A.html:661 - 'Annual CII (gCO2/DWT.nm or gCO2/GT.nm)'. Names BOTH capacity measures. Already correct.

QB3_J.html:189 - 'attained CII = CO2 emitted / (capacity x distance sailed), in gCO2/DWT.nm for my ship type'. States the capacity form FIRST and then scopes the DWT figure explicitly. This is the model formulation and would have been damaged by a pattern-only fix.
QB3_J.html:228 - 'CII units for container ships: gCO2/DWT.nm (AER)'. Scoped in the same clause.

QB1_K.html:237 - 'the capacity term C in the container-ship CII (gCO2/DWT.nm)'. Scoped, and the unit is being used as EVIDENCE in a tonnage-definitions card about what DWT is. Editing it would damage a GT/NT/DWT proposition to serve a CII one.

QB6.html#q13:1210 - '~0.8 gCO2/DWT.nm' inside a worked example that opens 'A container vessel with 12% propeller slip anomaly'. Scoped by the sentence before the unit rather than by a clause around it, which is why this one cannot be adjudicated from a grep line and had to be read in its card.
C_quoted_or_rejected_wording_KEPT: QB6.html#q1:242 - the trap 'So CII is always gCO2 per DWT.nm?' answered 'Wrong: that is true for the cargo categories only.' The defective wording is the QUESTION; removing it would remove the corpus's own inoculation against the defect.
D_historical_or_governance_artefact_NOT_: QB6.html:372 - the q2 correction footer added by this record, which necessarily quotes the wrong unit in order to name what was corrected.

artefacts.digest_pin_note: A cheat sheet is a revision surface, not a q-card, so it carries no card digest. This follows the convention CORR-CII-G2G4-20260901 set for the same file.
detail: Formula box: 'Attained CII (gCO2/DWT.nm) = S(M_fuel x Cf) / (DWT x Distance_nm)' now reads capacity.nm and C x Distance_nm.

Unit key-value row now reads gCO2 / capacity.nm, and TWO rows were added beneath it - 'Capacity C' giving the DWT / GT split, and 'Capacity source' giving MEPC.412(84) -> G1 section 4.2. The split is added rather than merely removed because a cheat sheet that drops DWT without saying what replaces it leaves the candidate with no capacity term at all.

The Nair tip 'Always say gCO2/DWT.nm. No pause.' was the worst site on the page: it drilled the wrong unit as a reflex, for the examiner the card names. It now drills the capacity form first and the ship-type answer second.
The CII-vs-GFI comparison table Unit row.
The cold-ironing mini-card sub-line 'DWT.nm excludes berth time' now reads 'capacity.nm denominator excludes berth time'.
artefacts.preserved: Layout, card order, colour classes, section labels, examiner cues, all Cf values, all rating bands, all dates and every unrelated revision point are unchanged. The EEDI/EEXI container reference line 'Ref Line = a x DWT^-c, a = 174.22, c = 0.201' was NOT touched: DWT is genuinely the correct variable there and it is an EEDI proposition, not a CII one.
artefacts.why_it_is_in_this_record: A cheat sheet is the surface a candidate actually revises from. Correcting the cards and leaving it is how CORR-GPT-T3C-CII-20260905 left QB6 teaching two versions of one unit for four hours.
